algorithm: Replace repeated complete string values of at least64 characters by references. Preserve all keys, positions, list order, field scope and original text in a task-local library. Never replace substrings or use audio, gold or reference text to choose rules.
actor_instructions: Explicitly apply each library rule at every reference in its local type/policy/boundary context.
decoder_scope: Audit reconstruction only; no generated text, additional model pass or external decision decoder.
runtime_change: Design probe opt-in only; training and production renderer unchanged.
meaning_limit: Exact field reconstruction does not establish model comprehension or functional equivalence of literal and referenced prompts.
next_decision: Do not select reference representation only to reduce tokens. Retain literal contract as primary design reference until input design and model evidence support a change.
remaining: model rule-reference comprehension on admitted truth
